scope: NEAR HACKATHON official rules and screening expectations; research only

mandatoryPublicationAndEligibilityRules.requirement: Public repository by development deadline and through judging
Public X demo post stating built at NEAR HACKATHON, with official account mention, hashtag and attached media
For local-only demos, reproducible README and video; screenshots alone insufficient
One submission per project and repository, with actual human-provided data and consent
mandatoryPublicationAndEligibilityRules.source: Start here; What the human decides; Submission API

mandatoryPublicationAndEligibilityRules.requirement: Judged development from 2026-10-19 to 2026-11-14; disclose prior baseline and diff when applicable
Maximum two independent projects per person; disclose the other name in each README when applicable

explicitlyAllowed.condition: own NEAR contract fitting the track, without mandatory partner integrations
local-only deployment, with the specified repository/README/video requirements
AI code, libraries, templates and own prior libraries with disclosure
existing repository, with clear judged diff for prior projects

notPublishedAsMandatoryOrNumericalDeduct: equal 20-point weights for five historical themes
nuances: Hosted demo is explicitly a plus under Q-012, but local-only is eligible.
Absence of an active-user requirement does not prove human judges can never consider usefulness or impact.
Lack of an external-audit requirement does not make actual security defects irrelevant.
Testnet eligibility does not permit presenting simulated actions as real settlement.
Optional prompts include the word Requirements inside example product briefs; these are not universal entry conditions.
One hundred percent of executed checks passing is a test result, not a 100/100 official project score.

recommendedInternalBenchmarks.name: documented startup and reachable review flow
complete company-to-employee payroll flow with explicit real/fixture boundary
duplicate, unknown-result, insufficient-funds and pause behavior
adversarial dispatch rejected before signing or broadcast
external outage, stale quote and late response handling
desktop, mobile and keyboard main journeys
automated accessibility plus documented manual subset
measured startup and journey durations with environment and repeat counts
independent reviewer reproduction without verbal assistance

changesRecommendedToPriorReport: Mark v2's 76/100 as a retired optional internal method, not a score inferred from this contest.
Remove automatic deductions for no active users, revenue, demand, public SLA, external audit, local-only operation or testnet-only scope.
Retain actionable code defects, claim mismatches and reproducibility failures with concrete evidence.
Do not replace unsupported deductions with a predetermined 99-plus result.
